_camps: Centre of each camp's locators in map11.bin.json (CommunityDragon, game/data/maps/shipping/map11). x to the right, y up.
_gold: Each monster kill is a jump in the active player's gold. Single-monster camps (and the big krug) give >= big_jump_gold.
_grouping: Kills closer than group_gap_seconds are one step of the clear (camps done at the same time, e.g. Krugs + Red).
_naming: A kill goes to the camp you spent most time within camp_work_radius of since the previous kill.
_scuttles: Kill in the river (x + y close to river_sum) after the scuttles spawn, with a gold jump >= scuttle_min_gold.
